map.计算常见榫卯结构的榫头长宽深尺寸，适配不同板厚与连接方式: Computes tenon length, width and depth for common mortise-and-tenon joints, adapted to different board thicknesses and connection types
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：Math.round(t×actualRatio×h: Core formulas (by input variable): Math.round(t×actualRatio×hf); Math.round((w-tenonWidth)÷2); Math.round((t-tenonThick)÷2)

map.家具榫卯设计：根据板厚、板宽与榫型（贯通榫/半榫/燕尾榫/明榫/暗榫/搭接榫）推: Furniture joint design: derive tenon thickness, width, depth and shoulder width from the board thickness, board width and joint type (through tenon / stub tenon / dovetail / exposed tenon / hidden tenon / lap joint), balancing strength and appearance.
map.不同木材强度补偿：软木榫头易松动，按硬度系数放大榫厚；硬木则可适当收紧。: Compensating for different wood strengths: tenons in softwood loosen easily, so the thickness is scaled up by a hardness factor; hardwood can be tightened slightly.
map.加工放样：给出颊高、肩宽等细部尺寸，便于开榫机与手工具对刀与留肩。: Layout for machining: cheek height, shoulder width and other detail dimensions are given, making it easy to set up tenoning machines and hand tools and to leave the shoulders.
map.示例：贯通榫 板厚25mm / 板宽100mm / 中硬木: Example: through tenon, board thickness 25 mm / board width 100 mm / medium-hard wood
map.榫厚 = 25 × 0.4 × 1.0 = 10mm（板厚 40%）；榫宽 =: Tenon thickness = 25 × 0.4 × 1.0 = 10 mm (40% of board thickness); tenon width = 100 × 0.7 = 70 mm (70% of board width); tenon depth = 25 × 3.0 = 75 mm (full through penetration); shoulder width on each side = (100 − 70) ÷ 2 = 15 mm; cheek height top and bottom = (25 − 10) ÷ 2 = 8 mm.
map.榫厚一般取板厚的多少？: What fraction of the board thickness is normally used for the tenon?
map.常用经验为板厚的 1/3–1/2（本工具对多数榫型取 0.33–0.6 的系数）: Common practice is 1/3–1/2 of the board thickness (this tool uses coefficients of 0.33–0.6 for most joint types). Too thin a tenon breaks easily, too thick weakens the parent member; around 0.4 is a safe choice for a through tenon.
map.软木和硬木的系数怎么调？: How are the coefficients adjusted for softwood and hardwood?
map.工具以硬度系数补偿：软木 1.1（榫厚略增防松）、中硬 1.0、硬木 0.9。硬: The tool compensates with a hardness factor: 1.1 for softwood (slightly thicker tenon to avoid loosening), 1.0 for medium-hard and 0.9 for hardwood. Hardwood is strong enough to tighten slightly, while softwood needs a thicker tenon or a wedge.
map.燕尾榫的 14° 角度有什么讲究？: What is special about the 14° angle of a dovetail?
map.燕尾角通常 8°–14°，角度越大咬合越紧、越不易拉脱，但加工与装配难度也上升。: The dovetail angle is usually 8°–14°: a larger angle grips tighter and resists pull-out better, but machining and assembly become harder. This tool uses 14° for dovetails, balancing strength and ease of assembly.
map.实际厚比 = 榫型基准厚比 × 用户比例 ÷ 0.4: Actual thickness ratio = joint-type base thickness ratio × user ratio ÷ 0.4
map.榫厚 = 板厚 × 实际厚比 × 木材硬度因子: Tenon thickness = board thickness × actual thickness ratio × hardness factor
map.榫宽 = 板宽 × 榫型宽比: Tenon width = board width × joint width ratio
map.榫深 = 板厚 × 榫型深比: Tenon depth = board thickness × joint-type depth ratio
map.两侧肩宽 = (板宽 − 榫宽) ÷ 2（每侧）: Shoulder width on both sides = (board width − tenon width) ÷ 2 (per side)
map.上下颊高 = (板厚 − 榫厚) ÷ 2（每侧）: Cheek height above and below = (board thickness − tenon thickness) ÷ 2 (per side)
map.燕尾榫另输出倾角: Dovetail joints also output the angle
map.软木提示：榫厚建议 +10% 或加木楔防松动: Softwood note: increase tenon thickness by 10% or add a wedge to prevent loosening
map.尺寸取整到毫米，实际按含水率纹理微调: Dimensions are rounded to millimeters; adjust for moisture content and grain in practice

map.榫厚倍率（相对该榫型基准）: Tenon thickness multiplier (relative to joint baseline)
map.榫深 = 板厚 × 榫型深比；肩宽 = (板宽 − 榫宽) ÷ 2: Tenon depth = board thickness × joint depth ratio; shoulder = (board width − tenon width) ÷ 2
map.实际厚比 = 榫型基准厚比 × 用户倍率（1.0 = 该榫型标准）: Actual thickness ratio = joint base ratio × user multiplier (1.0 = standard for this joint)
map.家具榫卯设计：按板厚、板宽、榫型与倍率推算榫厚、榫宽、榫深、肩宽与颊高，并给出几: Furniture joint design: derive tenon thickness, width, depth, shoulder and cheek height from board thickness, width, joint type and multiplier, with a geometric estimate for a first test fit.
map.不同木材强度补偿：软木按 1.1 系数略增榫厚、硬木按 0.9 略收；系数只是经: Hardness compensation: softwood uses 1.1 to thicken the tenon slightly and hardwood 0.9 to tighten it; these are starting points and still need test pieces.
map.加工放样与停止条件：计算后统一校验榫厚是否小于板厚、榫厚/榫宽/榫深是否至少 3: Layout and stop conditions: after calculating, check that the tenon is thinner than the board, thickness/width/depth are at least 3 mm, and cheek height and non-lap shoulder are at least 1 mm; outside these limits dimensions and the drawing are withheld.
map.示例：贯通榫 板厚25mm / 板宽100mm / 中硬木 / 倍率1: Example: through tenon, board 25 mm / width 100 mm / medium hardwood / multiplier 1
map.榫厚 = 25 × 0.4 × 1.0 = 10mm（板厚 40%）；榫宽 =: Tenon thickness = 25 × 0.4 × 1.0 = 10 mm (40% of board); width = 100 × 0.7 = 70 mm; depth = 25 × 3.0 = 75 mm; shoulder 15 mm each side; cheek height 7.5 mm each, rounded to 8 mm. At multiplier 2.5 the tenon reaches or exceeds board thickness, so the page withholds output and advises a lower multiplier or thicker board.
map.常用经验为板厚的 1/3–1/2；本工具基准系数 0.33–0.6，再乘倍率与硬: Common practice is 1/3–1/2 of board thickness; this tool uses base ratios of 0.33–0.6, then applies the multiplier and hardness factor. Whatever the ratio, the final tenon must be strictly thinner than the board, otherwise the shoulder or cheek geometry fails.
map.工具按硬度补偿：软木 1.1（略增防松）、中硬 1.0、硬木 0.9。硬木强度高: The tool compensates by hardness: softwood 1.1 (slightly thicker to reduce looseness), medium 1.0, hardwood 0.9. Hardwood can be slightly tighter; softwood may need thickening or wedges. These are starting points; adjust for moisture, grain and a dry fit.
map.为什么有时页面不显示尺寸？: Why are dimensions sometimes not shown?
map.当榫厚≥板厚、榫厚/榫宽/榫深小于 3mm、颊高小于 1mm，或非搭接榫单侧肩宽: When tenon thickness ≥ board thickness, thickness/width/depth is under 3 mm, cheek height under 1 mm, or a non-lap shoulder is under 1 mm per side, the combination is outside geometric or machining limits. The page withholds usable dimensions and the drawing, and suggests a thicker/wider board, lower multiplier or another joint.
